title: Where the OTA API and worker sit
caption: Every caller of the OTA API and everything the API and the worker talk to. The platform side is reached through tables, Redis and queues only, never synchronous HTTP. Click a node for details.

nodes.label: Traveller's browser
nodes.detail: Uses the hosted storefront (`<key>.ota.example.com`) or a third-party site.

nodes.label: Hosted storefront
nodes.detail: Static pages + SDK in cookie mode; every API call goes to `/api/*` on its own host.

nodes.label: Third-party frontend / server
nodes.detail: `X-Api-Key: pk_…` from a browser (origin allow-list) or `sk_…` from a server.

nodes.label: OTA admin (Next.js, :3002)
nodes.detail: Server-side only, on loopback: `OTA_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY`, staff bearer token, `X-Velexis-Environment`, end-user IP/agent headers.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: PaymentIntents (manual capture), refunds; posts signed webhooks to `/webhooks/stripe/**`.

nodes.label: Caddy (+ WAF)
nodes.detail: Proxies `api.ota.example.com` and `/api/*` of every storefront host to 127.0.0.1:4000; adds `X-Velexis-Edge` and `X-Velexis-Host` for storefront hosts; blocks `/internal/*` and `/health/ready`.

nodes.label: OTA API dist/main.js :4000
nodes.detail: 117 implemented operations + 19 deferred (`501`). Guards, OpenAPI validation, idempotency, tenantTx.

nodes.label: OTA worker dist/worker.js (health :4001)
nodes.detail: BullMQ consumers and schedulers: provisioning, Stripe events, payments, bookings sync/reconcile, ticketing, notifications, documents, maintenance.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16: tenant_<key>, reference, platform (read)
nodes.detail: Role `velexis_ota_app` (DML on tenant schemas); worker also `velexis_provisioner` for DDL.

nodes.label: Redis 7
nodes.detail: Caches, Amadeus tokens and buckets, rate limits, staff sessions, BullMQ queues (prefix `vx`).

nodes.label: Storage STORAGE_DIR
nodes.detail: `tenant_<key>/…` PDFs and storefront images (local disk adapter).

nodes.label: Platform API + worker
nodes.detail: Owns tenants, keys, memberships, connections. Sends `ota-tenant-ops`, consumes `platform-tenant-events`, publishes `vx:invalidate`, writes `ptk:*` portal tokens.

nodes.label: Amadeus Enterprise (stub :4900 locally)
nodes.detail: 12 operations: search, availability, upsell, price, create order, issue, order management, by-reference, queue list, OAuth.
